SELECT FN_MAKE_DATE_CODE('INORD') FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO tb_inord (company_code, inord_no, inord_date, due_date, dept, pic, cust_code, cust_name, total_supply_price, total_surtax, total_price, created_by, create_date) VALUES ('0000', #{inordNo}, #{inordDate}, #{dueDate}, #{dept}, #{pic}, #{custCode}, #{custName}, #{totalSupplyPrice}, #{totalSurtax}, #{totalPrice}, '박봉근', SYSDATE)

SELECT FN_MAKE_DATE_CODE('INORD_DETAIL') FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO tb_inord_detail (inord_detail_no, company_code, inord_no, sku, qty, unit_price, supply_price, surtax, price, remark, created_by, create_date) VALUES ( #{inordDetailNo}, '0000', #{inordNo}, #{sku}, #{qty}, #{unitPrice}, #{supplyPrice}, #{surtax}, #{price}, #{remark}, '박봉근', SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT ior.company_code, ior.inord_no, ior.inord_date, ior.cust_code, ior.cust_name, ior.total_price, ior.output_status, cm_output.code_name "output_status_name" FROM tb_inord ior JOIN tb_cm_code cm_output ON ior.output_status = cm_output.code AND cm_output.group_code = '0L' ORDER BY ior.create_date DESC

SELECT ior.company_code , ior.inord_no , ior.inord_date , ior.cust_code , ior.cust_name , iod.inord_detail_no , iod.sku , sku.sku_name , iod.qty , iod.unit_price , nvl(iod.supply_price, 0) supply_price , nvl(iod.surtax, 0) surtax , nvl(iod.price, 0) price , iod.output_status -- 출고여부 , cm_output.code_name "output_status_name" -- 출고여부명 , iod.invoice_status -- 세금계산서발행여부 , cm_invoice.code_name "invoice_status_name" -- 세금계산서발행여부명 FROM tb_inord ior JOIN tb_inord_detail iod ON ior.company_code = iod.company_code AND ior.inord_no = iod.inord_no JOIN tb_sku_master sku ON iod.company_code = sku.company_code AND iod.sku = sku.sku JOIN tb_cm_code cm_output ON iod.output_status = cm_output.code AND cm_output.group_code = '0L' JOIN tb_cm_code cm_invoice ON iod.invoice_status = cm_invoice.code AND cm_invoice.group_code = 'INVOICE_STATUS' WHERE 1=1
AND iod.inord_no = #{inordNo}
AND ior.cust_code LIKE '%' || #{custCode} || '%'
AND ior.cust_name LIKE '%' || #{custName} || '%'
AND iod.sku like '%' || #{sku} || '%'
AND sku.sku_name like '%'|| #{skuName} ||'%'
AND iod.invoice_status = '0'
AND iod.output_status != '0'
AND ior.inord_date = ior.inord_date AND ior.inord_no = ior.inord_no
